about: Hand-written answer key for the REAL evidence of case 010 (Evidence Generation/Cases/Case_010): one CCTV clip, two audio recordings, six text documents. HELD OUT: written before any pipeline run on this evidence was looked at. Events and people keep the generator's ids (cases/CASE_ATM_010.json); each evidence item lists everyone in it, the part they play, and the event they show.

built_from.audio: the .wav files themselves (transcribed for this key) and their manifests (start time, source, location)
built_from.video: the video agent's own log (agents/field_agents/video_agent/runs/CASE_ATM_010/CASE_ATM_010_video_log.json) - NOT checked against the clip by a person. Scoring the video agent against this part cannot catch the video agent's own mistakes.
built_from.voices: both recordings are in a similar low pitch range (139 / 124 Hz) with MFCC cosine 0.97 - consistent with one speaker, not proof of it.

findings_an_investigator_should_get.detail: The suspect's message 'Reader fitted. No one saw.' (10:02:49) is contradicted by the bystander filmed watching (10:03:28) and the caller describing the exit (10:03:25).

'Done here. Moving.' is stamped 10:02:48 - before 'Reader fitted' (10:02:49) and 40 s before the filmed exit (10:03:28). It is a forwarded message; its timestamp should not be trusted over the camera clock.
The 10:10 SMS (O11) failed its hash check; it should be flagged and excluded, not counted as a report.
The card reader fitting rests only on the suspect's own message; no footage shows it (the only clip is of the exit).
The FIR lists two witnesses; the evidence shows one bystander, and both recordings sound like one speaker.
